testimonials.title: What my
testimonials.subtitle: Real projects, real clients, real results.

clients.name: María González
clients.text: I needed a website quickly for my coffee shop and Mondi delivered it in two weeks. It turned out beautiful and my customers use it to see the menu and make reservations.

clients.name: Lucas Fernández
clients.text: He set up my complete Tienda Nube, uploaded the products and taught me how to manage it. Now I sell online without depending on anyone and without marketplace commissions.

clients.name: Ana Rodríguez
clients.text: Direct communication, no nonsense. He explained everything and always responded quickly. The website turned out exactly as I imagined. I have a professional and functional first-class website.

clients.name: Carlos Martínez
clients.text: He developed our VTEX platform with complex integrations. The technical level is excellent and he met all deadlines. Very professional.

clients.name: Sofía Pérez
clients.text: My Shopify store turned out amazing. He helped me with all the setup, payments and even trained me to manage it myself. Highly recommended.

clients.name: Diego Ramírez
clients.text: He made our consulting firm's institutional website in record time. Modern design, fast and with everything we needed. Excellent work.

clients.name: Valentina Torres
clients.text: I needed a portfolio that would showcase my work professionally. The result exceeded my expectations. The website is beautiful and works perfectly.

clients.name: Martín Silva
clients.text: He developed the online appointment system for our clinic. Now patients book through the website and we save hours of phone calls. Great.

clients.name: Laura Benítez
clients.text: My landing page turned out beautiful and now I receive orders via WhatsApp directly from the website. Simple, effective and exactly what I needed.
